name: Gatik
sub: Autonomous trucking L4; Goods delivery autonomy
about: Middle-mile autonomous box-truck company focused on fixed B2B retail and logistics routes. They are more commercially grounded than many robotaxi models because routes are repeatable and customer-specific.
deployment: Walmart, Kroger, Tyson and other retail / logistics routes historically; US and Canada
metrics: First US company operating fully driverless box trucks at commercial scale, 10 revenue trucks (Jan 2026) scaling toward hundreds, with $600M in customer contracts over five years.
signal: First in N. America to scale fully driverless box trucks; $600M contracted (Jan 2026)

sources.title: Hundreds of Gatik robot delivery trucks headed for U.S. roads
